investigation_notes.Description: An anomalously high volume of SharePoint file downloads (315) was observed from Marcus Webb to external destination 40.108.201.15, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 50 files. The activity includes several sensitive documents and occurred from an internal endpoint (HOST-WS-03) with a standard user agent. This pattern is consistent with potential data exfiltration or unauthorized data access, warranting high priority because it poses a risk to data confidentiality.
